② Park the trolley right by the boot.
③ Bend your knees, bag close to you.
④ Turn with your feet, not your waist.

caption:
Lulu does the weekly shop, then reaches from the trolley deep into the boot, and the lower back twinges every time.

The same bag held at arm's length while twisting asks more of your back. Keeping the load close and turning with your feet usually feels easier.

Hybi's boot routine: pack lighter bags, park the trolley right by the boot, bend your knees, keep the bag close, and turn with your feet, not your waist. Stop if your leg tingles.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
